full_judgment: 47. In the instant case the pre-emptee (petitioner) has alleged fraud. In support of such allegations he filed various documents including the copy of the notices served by the learned advocate for the pre-emptor petitioner in the earlier revision and certain other materials to show that the pre-emptee. was very much diligent in pursuing the Revision, but because of the alleged fraud, the learned Advocate engaged by him was unable to participate in the hearing of the Civil Revision which resulted in allowing the pre-emption by way of reversal of the concurrent decision of the Courts below. These allegations and other aspects of temporary injunction are to be considered in the Civil Revision pending before the learned District Judge, where the injunction matter is the subject matter.
